Thanks — I can see page 2 of 3 of **OIML Certificate No R76/2006-GB1-12.10**. Here's a summary of what this page contains:

## Conformity Statement
- Conformity was established by tests in pattern evaluation report **P00917** (13 pages).

## Characteristics of the Instrument
- Family of instruments using **A-Series and V-Series digital indicators** (AFS, AFM, ABM, ATM, APS, VFS, VFM, VBM, VTM, VPS models)
- Connected to a weighing platform forming a **Class III or IIII**, mains or battery-powered, self-indicating, single interval or dual interval/range, non-automatic weighing instrument
- May be used for **direct sales to the public**

## Main Features
- Stainless steel enclosure (AFS, APS, VFS, VPS) or plastic enclosure (AFM, ATM, ABM, VFM, VBM, VTM)
- 2.0" graphic LCD (most models) or 1.0" graphic LCD (APS and VPS)
- A/D conversion module, main board with processor
- 4-wire load cell connection (A-Series); 6-wire load cell connection (V-Series)

## Devices
- Initial and semi-automatic zero setting, zero tracking
- Semi-automatic subtractive tare balancing
- Determination of stability of equilibrium
- Zero indicator, net indicator
- Memory and totalisation, printing

## Load Cell Requirements
- Must have an **OIML R60 Certificate of Conformity** with necessary data for the manufacturer's declaration of compatibility
- Load cells marked **NH** allowed only if humidity testing to R76 was conducted on them
- Compatibility of load cells and indicator established via the compatibility of modules calculation at verification
- Load cell transmission must conform to a standard type

Is there anything specific you'd like me to do with this page — e.g., transcribe it verbatim, answer a question about the requirements, or compare it with another page?

I've reviewed page 3 of the OIML Certificate **R76/2006-GB1-12.10**. Here's a summary of the key content:

## Technical Data
| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Power supply | 9-12 VDC via mains adaptor (9V / 500 mA); 6 V / 4Ah rechargeable battery |
| Max scale intervals | 10,000 (Class III); 1,000 (Class IIII) |
| Maximum tare | -1/3 Max |
| Load cell excitation | 5 VDC |
| Load cell impedance | 85 Ω (min) – 1100 Ω (max) |
| Min input voltage per interval | 1 µV |
| Measuring range | -9.7 mV to 19.5 mV |
| Dead load signal voltage | 0 – 10 mV |
| Fraction of max permissible error | P_ind = 0.5 |
| Operating temperature | -10°C to +40°C |
| Load cell connection | 4 or 6-wire shielded; 6-wire max cable length 30 m |

## Interfaces
- Load cell 4 or 6-wire shielded connection
- RS232C (Serial, D-SUB 9)
- Centronic Printer Port (Parallel, D-SUB 25)

## Software & Sealing
- Software version **V1.2** (viewable via F2 function)
- Legally relevant parameters protected by a jumper on the main board
- Enclosures and load cell connection sealed using a wire-and-seal method

## Certificate History
- **R76/2006-GB1-12.10** — first issued **02 October 2012**
